cohort: Sixty patients undergoing elective lower segment caesarean section under spinal anesthesia, with 30 assigned to receive 0.75% hyperbaric Ropivacaine and 30 to receive 0.5% hyperbaric Bupivacaine.
finding: 0.75% hyperbaric Ropivacaine provided a faster onset of sensory block, shorter duration of sensory and motor block, and fewer complications compared to 0.5% hyperbaric Bupivacaine, with comparable block quality for elective Caesarean sections.
mod_finding: 0.75% hyperbaric Ropivacaine facilitated earlier recovery from motor blockade, which aided in the early ambulation of patients undergoing Caesarean section.
